thread:
Maya (AE): quick ask — AtlasHealth wants to run a 6-week POC with EU + APAC restriction for PHI. They need: explicit subprocessors list scoped by region, confirmation that inference + storage never leave specified regions, and a conservative delta for a small reserved pool. Can ops/legal advise?
Ethan (SE): clarifying q — do they accept global control-plane metadata (tokens, routing) or do they require control-plane inside EU/APAC too?
Aya (Customer): control-plane metadata fine as long as no user content leaves the region. They prefer BYOK, and want HSM-backed keys if possible. Also asking if we support regional failover without egress to third regions.
Priya (Legal): we can provide subprocessors manifest and the standard attestation pack (SOC2/ISO). If they require control-plane in-region, that's a Private deployment. We'll need to flag any subprocessors that use non-EU/APAC infra.
Liam (Infra Ops): hosted = latency-affinity routing, not hard lockdown. Dedicated supports tenant pinning per region with in-region KV/cache + storage. We can do EU (eu-central-1) and APAC (ap-northeast-1) pinning. HSM BYOK provisioning ETA ~2 weeks; HSM-backed BYOK adds ~1 week.
Ethan (SE): for engineering — sample dev endpoints we can show:
```
# APAC pinned inference endpoint
POST https://api.redwood-inference.ap/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Control plane (global): `https://control.redwood-inference.com/signal` — note: sends only routing/auth metadata, no user content.
Maya (AE): pricing note — AtlasHealth is price-sensitive. Ethan, ballpark for small reserved pool (sustained ~80 QPS across two regions)?
Ethan (SE): ballpark: dual-region small reserved (equiv 6xA100 split) ~ +$20k–26k/mo above hosted. If they do single-region dedicated with burst to the other on failover, cheaper (~+$12k–15k). Enabling int8 quant + batching could cut token costs ~20–30%. Will produce a tighter quote.
Priya (Legal): I'll generate DPA + subprocessors spreadsheet. If they need subprocessors certified within region, we'll mark which ones have EU/APAC data centres and provide contact windows.
infra-bot: maintenance notice — ap-northeast-1 scheduled network patch 2025-01-14 02:00-03:00 JST; no data-plane downtime expected.
Liam (Infra Ops): ops checklist we'll need from customer for BYOK and pinning:
```
- Preferred regions to pin (list)
- Expected sustained QPS and peak burst
- BYOK: public key, KMS contact, rotation cadence
- Approved IP ranges for customer-to-api (if IP allowlist required)
- Required certs / attestations (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI if applicable)
- POC start date window and rollback plan
```
Aya (Customer): pls also include a short spreadsheet for subprocessors, and a sample addendum text we can show procurement. Procurement wants a single-sheet checklist.
Maya (AE): copy — Priya / Liam will drop the subprocessors sheet + ops checklist and I will package with pricing.
Priya (Legal): will send subprocessors CSV + standard addendum by EOD today. If AtlasHealth requests control-plane in-region we will escalate to Private deployment track and estimate lead time.
Ethan (SE): security note: we can enable request-level prefix masking for PII fields and provide eval harness to show no content leaves pinned regions. We'll add that to the technical appendix.
Aya (Customer): excellent. I'll loop procurement and security and come back with KMS contact + timeline. Thanks everyone :heart:
Maya (AE): thanks team — tagging for deal room handoff.
